thread:
clara: Heads-up: I'm seeing inconsistent percentile signals on the latency dashboard for /v1/query. Top card p95=160ms but region breakdown for sa-east shows p95=470ms.

diego: Are the sample_count numbers aligned? small-slice+tdigest often causes weird tails.

clara: Top card: sample_count=14,800. sa-east slice: sample_count=260.

sylvia: Can you paste the quick rollup query?

clara: Query I ran:
```
select region, sample_count, p50, p95, p99 from latency_rollups
where endpoint='/v1/query' and ts between 1805008400 and 1805008760;
-- global 14800 58 160 380
-- sa-east 260 60 210 470
```

diego: Looks like a localized tail. Check routing events around 1805008600. If quota fallback hit we might have a subset routed to a slower variant.

ops-bot: routing: fallback event tenant=partner-co route=/v1/query at=1805008622 reason=reserved_capacity_throttle fallback_target=cpu-variant-2

sylvia: That matches. UX problem: on-callers glance at top-card and miss region tails. We should make that mismatch explicit.

clara: UX ideas: (1) surface sample_count next to p50/p95/p99 on the top card, (2) show a tiny sparkline of per-region p95s to reveal skew, (3) a "skew" flag when one slice contributes >45% of the global tail.

diego: Infra: for dashboard comparatives, consider computing percentiles from raw samples for slices with sample_count < 1000 before merging t-digests. That avoids low-count merge bias. Will file INFRA-4720.

sylvia: Short term: UI badge + sparkline + tooltip explaining "t-digest merge caveat" will help. Long term infra fallback to raw-samples for small slices. Also annotate charts when routing fallback events occur so spikes line up with quota actions.

clara: Can someone open the PR? Small UI change, should be low-risk.

diego: Filing INFRA-4720: "raw-sample fallback for low-count slices used in dashboard percentile merges" with threshold=1000 and tests.

sylvia: I'll open a tiny console PR adding sample_count badge, per-region mini-sparkline and tooltip. Assigning copy to @diego. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1012 (WIP)

ops-bot: Deploy notice: console PR #1012 canary -> 12% in 7m.

clara: Thanks. Action items:
- sylvia: land UI badge + sparkline + tooltip (console#1012)
- diego: INFRA-4720 + unit tests + edge-case comparison tests
- clara: update runbook with quick checklist: check sample_count, check routing fallback events, inspect per-caller slices

Follow-up: reconvene at 1805009400 to confirm the dashboard shows the skew indicator and annotate the postmortem if needed. :thumbsup:
